hooks.command: r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills"; for s in "$r"/.claude/skills/*/; do [ -d "$s" ] && ln -sfn "${s%/}" "$HOME/.claude/skills/"; done; mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/rules"; for f in "$r"/.claude/rules/*.md; do [ -f "$f" ] && ln -sf "$f" "$HOME/.claude/rules/"; done; true
